lines.opener: *tip-tap, tip-tap: a little man under a hedge doesn't look up from his shoe* Is it gold ye're after? Ye're all after gold. Well, there's none. G'way.
lines.openerHostile: *he leaps up on his stool, brandishing an awl* Back, ye great lump! Not one penny! Not ONE!
lines.like: *the hammer pauses* ...Hmph. Ye're not as thick as ye look.
lines.dislike: *tip-TAP, hard* Sure and I don't know what ye're on about. Nothing at all.
lines.flirt: *drops his hammer and goes pink to the tips of his ears* G'way out of that, ye eejit! *he doesn't look displeased*
lines.join: *tucks the shoe into his apron* Ah, go on, then. Someone has to mend them boots of yours.
lines.demand: That'll be a hundred for the shoe. One shoe. Finest ye'll ever wear. Pay up.
lines.gift: *sighs like it pains him, and hands over a single tiny shoe* There. Don't say I never gave ye nothing.
lines.letPass: *waves the hammer* Go on, go on. Mind ye don't trip on a boliaun.
lines.ai: A what? Ye're soft in the head. Tip-tap.
lines.refuseJoin: Is it daft ye are? I've work to do!
lines.leaveNow: *points over your shoulder* Would ye look at that! There's a monster behind ye! Go on, look!
